test_cases.name: adapt_existing_app
test_cases.input: Review this SwiftUI view and adapt it for iPhone Duo. It currently uses fixed frames and a bottom toolbar.
assertions: Identifies fixed widths as a problem and suggests container-relative sizing
Recommends size classes (compact width outer, regular width inner)
Keeps the toolbar in a navigation container so the system can present it vertically
Mentions safe area insets and fold avoidance
Suggests running scripts/duo-lint on the file

test_cases.name: split_view_recommendation
test_cases.input: My mail-style app needs to show list and detail on the big inner screen but a single pane when closed. How should I structure it?
assertions: Recommends NavigationSplitView or UISplitViewController
Notes automatic collapse on the outer display
Emphasizes a consistent hierarchy across poses
Mentions that standard split views adapt column widths to the fold
Points to templates/*/SplitViewCollapse.swift

test_cases.name: fold_handling
test_cases.input: Buttons keep landing in the center curve when the Duo is partially folded. What's the right way to fix this?
assertions: Prefers system components first
Names GeometryProxy.reservedRegions(kind:options:layoutDirectionBehavior:) or UIView.reservedRegions(kind:options:) with the .division kind
Filters or checks isActive; mentions the fold is inactive with zero width when flat
Says scrollable content need not avoid the fold and warns against dramatic rearrangements
Suggests testing with Device Hub's Partially Open button

test_cases.name: outer_display_controls
test_cases.input: On the closed Duo the screen is shorter. Where should my tab bar and nav buttons go?
assertions: Controls move to the side to maximize vertical space
Notes the inner display in portrait is the exception with horizontal bars
Says standard components get this automatically
Content offsets via safe areas
Mentions title plus symbol for toolbar items

test_cases.name: no_invented_apis
test_cases.input: What's the exact iPhone Duo screen size in points, and what's the API to get the hinge width so I can hard-code my layout?
assertions: States Apple does not publish point dimensions or the folded fold width
Does not invent numbers or API names
Recommends reading reserved region frames and safe area insets at runtime
References references/sources.md or api-index.md

test_cases.name: size_class_table
test_cases.input: What size classes does iPhone Duo report on each display and orientation?
assertions: Outer portrait: compact horizontal, regular vertical
Outer landscape: compact horizontal, compact vertical
Inner: regular horizontal, regular vertical
Says Apple doesn't state Split View half size classes on these pages
Advises against branching on interface orientation

test_cases.name: run_linter
test_cases.input: Scan my iOS project at ./App for iPhone Duo issues and summarize what to fix.
assertions: Runs scripts/duo-lint ./App (optionally --format json)
Groups findings by rule id and severity
Treats findings as heuristics to confirm in code
Proposes fixes using templates or api-index APIs

test_cases.name: arrangement_choice
test_cases.input: I have a video player with a chat panel layered over it in a ZStack. How should it behave when the Duo folds?
assertions: Recommends an overlay ArrangementView (or UIArrangementViewController with .overlay)
Explains primary goes trailing/bottom and secondary leading/top when partially open
Mentions overlayArrangementZIndex or state(for:).zIndex for a collapsed form
Keeps navigation outside and avoids nesting in List/ScrollView
Flags that a dedicated 'collapse secondary' API is not documented on the API pages

test_cases.name: single_button_sheet
test_cases.input: My settings sheet has only a Done button. On the closed Duo it moves to the side and looks odd. Can I keep it horizontal?
assertions: Uses toolbarVerticalBehavior(.disabled) in SwiftUI or preferredVerticalBarBehavior returning .disabled in UIKit
Notes the sheet then stops short of the front camera
Advises treating it as a stable choice, not toggled by state
Points to templates/*/SheetVerticalBarOptOut.swift

test_cases.name: game_fill
test_cases.input: My landscape-locked game letterboxes on the Duo's inner display. What should I do?
assertions: Fill the screen in every pose; prefer changing aspect ratio over letterboxing
If bars are unavoidable, fill them with artwork
Keep text and control sizes consistent
Mentions the inner display doesn't honor supported orientations (app scales)
Says Apple documents no Duo-specific game API on these pages

test_cases.name: preview_tools
test_cases.input: How can I preview my screens for iPhone Duo without the device?
assertions: Recommends the Device Hub iPhone Duo simulator for fold, cameras and bars
Offers templates/swiftui/DuoPreviewMatrix.swift for size-class branches
Offers tools/duo-preview.html for screenshot overlays
Notes neither preview helper invents device dimensions

test_cases.name: review_screen
test_cases.input: Review our checkout screen for iPhone Duo and tell me if it's ready to ship.
assertions: Follows prompts/review-screen.md
Runs duo-lint, scores references/review-rubric.md areas 0-3, applies the ship bar
Lists applicable test-plan case IDs with Device Hub steps
Outputs the rubric report template and unverified assumptions

test_cases.name: migration
test_cases.input: We have a 5-year-old UIKit app. Give me a plan to support iPhone Duo.
assertions: Follows references/migration-guide.md order: SDK/baseline, screen/idiom/orientation, resizing, bars, sheets, fold, games/camera, Liquid Glass, verify
Mentions Xcode 27.1 or later and the iOS 27.1 SDK for full-screen and vertical bars
Replaces UIScreen.main and custom UIToolbar usage
Ends with test plan, rubric, and references/app-store.md

test_cases.name: install_paths
test_cases.input: How do I install this skill in Claude Code, Cursor and Codex?
assertions: Claude Code: plugin marketplace add Belweave/iphone-duo-design then install iphone-duo-design@belweave, or ~/.claude/skills
Cursor: ~/.cursor/skills or .cursor/skills (optionally the .mdc rule or AGENTS.md)
Codex: ~/.agents/skills or repo .agents/skills, plus AGENTS.md
Optionally npx skills add Belweave/iphone-duo-design

test_cases.name: app_store_badge_and_deadline
test_cases.input: How do we get the optimized for iPhone Duo badge, and when do Duo screenshots become required?
assertions: Says uploading iPhone Duo screenshots is what shows the badge on the product page
Quotes both April 2027 wordings: screenshot specifications say any app using the iOS 27.1 SDK or later, and the news post says any apps or games submitted
Does not collapse the two wordings into one rule
Points at references/app-store.md
Mentions featuring Helpful Details should say the app supports every pose
Summarizes App Review Guidelines 2.3.14 (creative assets) and 2.5.19 (no hidden features), updated October 16, 2026

test_cases.name: apple_skill_and_sdk_tiers
test_cases.input: Should I use Apple's Xcode skill or this one, and which SDK do I need before April 2027?
assertions: Names xcrun agent skills export and Apple's App Resizability skill
Says Apple's skill finds most issues and this skill covers the rest
iOS 26 SDK or earlier: centered with empty space when open
iOS 27 SDK: fills most of the inner display and still avoids the status bar on the right
iOS 27.1 SDK with Xcode 27.1 or later: full display and vertical bars
April 2027 uploads must use the iOS 27 SDK; side bars still need the iOS 27.1 SDK

test_cases.name: camera_hinge_windows
test_cases.input: Our camera app should follow the person as the Duo opens, react to the hinge, and show a script on the outer display. Also, can we open a second window while it's closed?
assertions: Names the virtual front camera and AVCaptureDeviceDirectionCoordinator
Says position is not the same as the direction the camera faces
Names onHingeChange(isEnabled:_:) or UIHingeInteraction, and says hinge data is for effects rather than layout
Names CameraCaptureAccessory or UISceneAccessory.cameraCapture for outer-display content during capture
Says new windows can be created on the inner display only, and to use UIWindowScene.ActivationAction

test_cases.name: liquid_glass_and_live_activity
test_cases.input: We set UIDesignRequiresCompatibility so we can skip Liquid Glass, and our Live Activity gets cut off on Duo. What should we change?
assertions: Says the system ignores UIDesignRequiresCompatibility when you build for iOS 27 or later, so the app can't opt out of Liquid Glass
Points at the key's documentation page
Tells the Live Activity to read isDynamicIslandLimitedInWidth and fit the compact or minimal view in a 28pt circle
Mentions duo-lint DUO018

test_cases.name: fold_aware_layout
test_cases.input: We're designing a mail app for iPhone Duo. When the phone is closed the message is full screen. What should happen when it opens, where does Delete go, and how should we preview the fold before we have a device?
assertions: Uses two layouts, narrow and wide, rather than a layout per pose
Opening the phone places the message beside its parent and keeps the path order
Delete, or any destructive action, goes only in the overflow menu
Points at tools/fold-preview.html with a fold slider and mockup slots
Says to test on a real iPhone Duo, not only the simulator
Treats references/fold-aware-layout.md as belweave practice, separate from Apple's pages
